verdict.rationale: Grok Bot gives each Bot its own isolated cloud computer, separate from the user's machine. Actions are gated: per-command approval is required for local execution, Allow once/Always allow/Deny prompts and Auto Review check tool calls before they run, and team network-destination controls limit what computers can reach. These provide some execution isolation and guardrails, but nothing documents a sandbox or test mode that keeps a Bot away from real production accounts and data. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or dry-run mode, separation of test vs. production data and credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
